details.parties_quote: This Statement of Work ("SOW") is entered into on ____________ 2026 between Sunrise Foods Pvt Ltd, having its registered office at Sunrise House, NH 66 Bypass, Edappally, Kochi 682024, Kerala, India ("Client"), and AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3 ("AtliQ").

payment_source.quote: AtliQ shall invoice each Milestone Fee on acceptance of the relevant Milestone. The Client shall pay within thirty (30) days of receipt of invoice, as per the MSA.

details.services_summary: Extend distributor portal v2 and build a sales performance dashboard with Power BI, mobile-responsive design, ERP integration and Malayalam/Tamil support.

liability_cap.basis: as set out in the MSA
liability_cap.quote: limitation of liability... are as set out in the MSA

delay_penalty.quote: If AtliQ fails to achieve a Milestone by its Target Date for reasons attributable to AtliQ, the Client shall be entitled to a service credit equal to 0.5% (half a percent) of the Milestone Fee of the delayed Milestone for each complete week of delay.
